rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a space rocket or rocket-propelled spacecraft.

example.english: The Chinese astronauts blasted off aboard a rocket.
example.traditional: 中國太空人搭乘火箭升空。
example.jyutping: zung1 gwok3 taai3 hung1 jan4 daap3 sing4 fo2 zin3 sing1 hung1

rows.note: Use this for a firework rocket that shoots into the sky, rather than a space vehicle.

example.english: Children love watching a rocket burst open in the night sky.
example.traditional: 細路仔最鍾意睇沖天炮喺夜空爆開。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 cung1 tin1 paau3 hai2 je6 hung1 baau3 hoi1
